issuer: Texas Committee on Professional Ethics (State Bar of Texas)
title: Texas Ethics Opinion 11
text:
Opinion 11
February 1948
Question Presented
Whether it is proper for a member of the State Bar who is a state senator or state representative to so state on his professional card.
18 Baylor L. Rev. 198 (1966)
PROFESSIONAL CARDS - LEGISLATORS
An attorney may not state on his professional card that he is a State Senator or State Representative.
Canon 39.
Such a reference in the professional card of a member of the State Bar would violate Canon 39. (7-0)
Bluebook Citation
Tex. Comm. On Professional Ethics, Op. 11 (1948)
